title.zh: 将索索贡省Magallanes市镇Magallanes医疗医院由15张床位的医疗医院扩建升级为25张床位的区医院，名称为Magallanes区医院，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Expanding and Upgrading the Magallanes Medicare Hospital in the Municipality of Magallanes, Province of Sorsogon, From a Fifteen-bed Capacity Medicare Hospital Into a Twenty-five-bed Capacity District Hospital, to Be Known as the Magallanes District Hospital, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The Magallanes Medicare Hospital in the Municipality of Magallanes, Province of Sorsogon, is hereby expanded and upgraded from a fifteen-bed capacity medicare hospital into a twenty-five-bed capacity district hospital, to be known as the Magallanes District Hospital.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
